name: ffmpeg
purpose: Universal CLI multimedia engine for converting, trimming, and processing video and audio.
explanation: Created by Fabrice Bellard, `ffmpeg` decodes, filters, and re-encodes nearly any audio or video format directly from the command line (and powers VLC and browsers under the hood).

parameters.description: Applies video filters such as scaling (`scale=480:-1`) or frame rate (`fps=10`).

expectedOutput:
Input #0, mov,mp4 -> Output #0, gif, to 'output.gif'
frame=   30 fps= 60 q=-0.0 Lsize=   412kB time=00:00:03.00
whenToUse: When converting screen recordings into GIFs or transcoding/trimming video/audio from the terminal (Worksheet 13a).
commonMistakes: Putting output flags before `-i <input>`—in `ffmpeg`, flag order determines whether an option applies to input or output.
moduleTitle: C13 — Meeting New Tools, Libraries & AI Rules
platformCompatibility: macOS (`brew install ffmpeg`), Linux (`sudo apt install ffmpeg`), Windows
explanationOfOutput: Reports detected input streams, applied filter graph, encoded frames, and final output file size.
commonErrors: `Output file #0 does not contain any stream`
